verdict.rationale: LlamaExtract is the product's own extraction API: the developer defines an extraction configuration including a schema, submits a document via the web UI, Python SDK or REST API, and gets back JSON in that schema, with optional citations for checking values against the source. The docs do not explicitly say the schema is standard JSON Schema or describe how output is validated against it, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit JSON Schema input format, documented schema validation and error behavior for returned fields, independent hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I supply a JSON schema and get back validated structured fields extracted from the document

citations.quote: Extract returns JSON in your schema
Pull structured JSON out of documents that matches my schema
Just define your Extraction Configuration (schema and settings), drag and drop any supported document into LlamaParse and extract data from your documents.
Extract is available as a web UI, Python SDK and REST API.
Verify values against the source document when extracting from complex financial documents.
